title: Finite nets from the scaled deformation theorem (Simon 5.1–5.4 and the proof of 7.2, (1)–(3))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with n := m + 1 < P. Then there is c ∈ [0, ∞) (NNReal) with the following property. For every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, every Λ ∈ [0, ∞) and every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is a finite set 𝒬 ⊆ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) such that every integer multiplicity A ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with spt A ⊆ K, M(A) ≤ Λ and M(∂A) ≤ Λ admits Q ∈ 𝒬, R ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P) and S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with: R and ∂Q are integer multiplicity; A − Q − S = ∂R (Simon: A − Q = ∂R + S); M(R) + M(S) ≤ ε; M(∂Q) ≤ c·M(∂A); and spt R ⊆ cthickening(1, K) = {x : dist(x, K) ≤ 1}. Masses are in [0, ∞], M = mass = M_{ℝ^P} with the Euclidean coefficient norm, and spt = GeometricCurrentOn.support.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : NNReal, ∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : NNReal) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), IsCompact K → 0 < ε → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity A → A.support ⊆ K → A.mass ≤ Λ → A.boundary.mass ≤ Λ → ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Q.boundary ∧ A - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ ε ∧ Q.boundary.mass ≤ c * A.boundary.mass ∧ R.support ⊆ cthickening 1 K
